purpose: Development-only exact search over the four physically motivated bypass edges, assessing global latency/throughput guards and GPU work. This is not a formal confirmation or a novelty claim.
mask_interpretation: Bit i opens edge_order[i] in addition to every canonical edge. mask15 reproduces the current static gate; mask00 is canonical only.
selection_rule: Among masks satisfying all guards in both development seeds, minimize mean GPU seconds/output token; break ties by smaller maximum seed GPU work, then fewer admitted detours, then lower integer mask. If none pass, select no candidate. Do not alter guards after seeing results.
next_step_if_selected: Recheck selected mask against full and mask15 on distinct 300 s development seeds under a separately frozen protocol before any unseen 1800 s formal seeds.
claim_limit: A selected edge subset is an exploratory configuration, not evidence that the black-box search is independently novel or transferable.
